**Scope:** The capture writer end to end: crates/lisa-cli/src/capture_usage.rs (run_capture_usage / resolve_key), the embedded Stop hook generated by crates/lisa-cli/src/templates.rs, the live .lisa/hooks/on-stop.sh, and crates/lisa-cli/data/hooks-guide.md. Stops keying by inherited LISA_TICKET_ID and overwriting; appends a CaptureRecord of honest facts instead; and makes a stop that captures nothing loud rather than silent.

**Story acceptance:** Running `lisa capture-usage` twice for the same pane with two different transcripts appends two CaptureRecords (pane_id / session_id / captured_at / tokens) and writes no `<ticket>.usage.json`; and a stop whose transcript is empty, missing, or unreadable writes an operator-visible no-capture marker instead of returning a silent Ok(()), with the Stop hook no longer redirecting lisa's stderr to /dev/null.

**Honest boundary:** The writer only records facts and marks empties — MAPPING a capture to its owning ticket and quarantining the unmappable is the plugin's job in S-043-03. Deferred and named: Claude cache-split dimensions stay collapsed into a single input/output pair (separate P3 — Provider parity at the contract boundary parity signal). Fixture-proven and FREE.

## DAG

```
T-043-02-01  append-capture-not-overwrite  ← T-043-01-01
T-043-02-02  loud-no-write-signal  ← T-043-02-01
```

Wave rationale: 02-01 (append instead of overwrite) must land before 02-02 (loud no-write): both edit run_capture_usage's control flow and the no-capture marker rides the same record-emission path, so they are strictly sequential on one file with no safe parallelism.

**Out of this slice:** Plugin-side attribution, quarantine, and the end-to-end repro (S-043-03); the pane×time ownership lookup (S-043-01); cache-split parity; any new usage reporting surface.
